body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Casio(www.casio.com) introduced digital camera 'TRYX' which can be connected to SNS(Social Netword Service) after shooting with free angle at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
